name: Blockbench
description: electron-updater sha512 + notarization. BUT plugin store executes fetched JS via new Function(), no hash/sig.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Blockbench disables automatic download and gates download on user approval; its plugin loader executes fetched plugin code without a separate integrity check.
limitations: Newly recovered source snapshot; this is not historical release re-verification. Released artifacts and external framework enforcement remain unverified.

original_evidence.text: | Blockbench | https://github.com/JannisX11/blockbench | Electron (desktop) + web | Y (app-update); separately Y for plugin store | app-update: auto-check on startup (`autoUpdater.checkForUpdates()`), `autoDownload=false` (download gated on user clicking "allow"), `autoInstallOnAppQuit=true`; plugin store: manual install/toggle by user | app-update: Y (electron-updater downloads and installs the new build); plugin store: Y — plugin JS is fetched and executed with no sandboxing | app-update: https (electron-updater → GitHub Releases); plugin store: https enforced in code (throws if URL doesn't start with `https`) | app-update: N (no independently-signed manifest beyond electron-builder's auto-generated `latest.yml`); plugin store: N (no manifest at all) | app-update: hash-from-manifest (sha512 embedded in electron-builder's `latest.yml`) + OS-code-signing (macOS `hardenedRuntime`+notarization via `scripts/notarize.js`, entitlements); plugin store: **none** — no hash/signature check of any kind | app-update: none beyond HTTPS+GitHub Releases trust (no separate maintainer signing key found in repo); OS-code-signing key = Apple Developer ID cert (external, not in repo) | `electron/main.js:11,304-330` (`require('electron-updater')`, `autoUpdater.checkForUpdates()`/`downloadUpdate()`/`autoInstallOnAppQuit`); `package.json:193` (`"electron-updater": "^6.7.3"`), `package.json` `build.mac.hardenedRuntime`+`afterSign: scripts/notarize.js`; `js/plugin_loader.ts:39` (plugin CDN base `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/JannisX11/blockbench-plugins/plugins`), `:668-694` (`#runPluginFile` — `$.ajax`/`fetch` over http(s), throws if not https), `:697-704` (`#runCode` — `new Function('requireNativeModule','require', code)(scoped_require, scoped_require)`, i.e. arbitrary plugin JS executed with no hash/signature check); repo-wide grep for `integrity\|sha256\|checksum\|signature\|publicKey` in `js/`/`electron/` returns zero relevant hits. |

fields.label: has_updater
fields.value: Y (app-update); separately Y for plugin store

fields.label: auto
fields.value: app-update: auto-check on startup (`autoUpdater.checkForUpdates()`), `autoDownload=false` (download gated on user clicking "allow"), `autoInstallOnAppQuit=true`; plugin store: manual install/toggle by user

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: app-update: Y (electron-updater downloads and installs the new build); plugin store: Y — plugin JS is fetched and executed with no sandboxing

fields.label: transport
fields.value: app-update: https (electron-updater → GitHub Releases); plugin store: https enforced in code (throws if URL doesn't start with `https`)

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: app-update: N (no independently-signed manifest beyond electron-builder's auto-generated `latest.yml`); plugin store: N (no manifest at all)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: app-update: hash-from-manifest (sha512 embedded in electron-builder's `latest.yml`) + OS-code-signing (macOS `hardenedRuntime`+notarization via `scripts/notarize.js`, entitlements); plugin store: **none** — no hash/signature check of any kind

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: app-update: none beyond HTTPS+GitHub Releases trust (no separate maintainer signing key found in repo); OS-code-signing key = Apple Developer ID cert (external, not in repo)
